glossary.ja: ディストーションフィールド
glossary.role: Nadesico's gravity-wave barrier; also the Aestivalis/Nadesico-unit defensive weapon in the tutorial.

glossary.ja: ウィンゲルバインダー
glossary.role: Weapon 4 of the A.Taul (Gablae's Heavy Metal): two arm-mounted binders launched by remote control.
Neo Japan Gundam Fighter (Shining Gundam, then God Gundam); King of Hearts and leader of the Shuffle Alliance
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, brash, impulsive and impatient; socially awkward, but has a strong sense of justice. Prone to loud battle cries.

glossary.role: Domon's second Mobile Fighter (GF13-017NJII), Neo Japan; God Finger and Hyper Mode (Meikyo Shisui)
God Gundam's power-up state, triggered when Domon's fighting spirit gauge peaks (tutorial m6302#179-183).
HUD gauge for boosting.
The type of Antibody that rebels against Orphan; generic Brain Powerd unit (also the series title)

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Teleportation/time-displacement technology of the setting
Defensive field of aura machines and aura ships; Weapon 4 of the Dunbine-family units (reduces damage for a time).
Network of (hundreds of) orbital military satellite cannons of the Rainen Project; Gun Ark/Buster Ark can call it via the Guardian System.
Neue Ziel's wired claw arms, fired from the main arms (有線クローアーム = Wired Claw Arm).
The Layzner's (and Zakaal's) overdrive system: wraps the unit in a blue magnetic field for a high-speed charge that is impervious to lasers ('Blue Comet').
Unit ability; game also writes アビリティー.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Intermediate (legged fighter) mode of the VF-1 Valkyrie.
Shoulder/arm weapon-pod of Heavy Metals; short for ウィンゲルバインダー / ラウンドバインダー / サーカスバインダー.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Humanoid mode of the VF-1 Valkyrie (バトロイド形態 = Battroid mode).

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: U.N. Spacy VF-1 variable fighter series.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Jet-fighter mode of the VF-1 Valkyrie (ファイター形態 = Fighter mode).
The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Boost dash.
Boost thrust resource (バーニア消費).
God Gundam's higher state (明鏡止水モード) reached when Domon's heart attains a serene mind.
Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer
